mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) are stable or increasing, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS stable/increasing
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 10% YoY and RSAFS is stable/increasing.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 2% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) remains stable, it signals a potential supply constraint, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY and INDPRO stable
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY and INDPRO is stable.
